description: This file defines a React component `ExploreMindmapView`, which visualizes a mind map of recommended roles and allows filtering and interaction with the map. It manages state, fetches recommendations via API calls, and renders a canvas and details panel.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an input to a trimmed string, handling null or undefined values.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an input to an array of trimmed strings, filtering out falsy values.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a string identifier from a role object, considering multiple possible property names.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role title from a role object.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number within a specified min and max range.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses salary range information from a role object, returning min and max values in lakhs.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Determines if a role matches selected industry, skills, and salary filters.

methods.name: fetchRecommendations
methods.description: Fetches recommended roles from API endpoints for a given persona ID.

methods.name: toViewport
methods.description: Converts stored view state into a viewport object with pan and zoom.

methods.name: toState
methods.description: Converts viewport and selection data into a stored view state.
